polarized_reviews.text: My initial experience was very informative. I learned that all vegetables and fruits are not good for diabetics and cause blood sugar spikes. I can't wait to find out what other valuable information this app contains. I love it so far.

I don't know about the apps, because I tend to ignore them. I find the information very helpful. Plus there are a variety of topics touching on all aspects of diabetes self care. I generally read over a section or two at night, before I go to bed. It helps me plan the next few days for food and exercise. All in all, the site is a Godsend.

Very informative. I like how each section breaks the information down in such a way as to really understand it in a very simple method. I am Type 2 and have really been battling with my glucose levels, with this app it will be easier for me to, I believe, get it under control, and I feel I can stay on track with my diet and physical activity regimen. Thank you for putting this all together and offering it for free.

I just downloaded this app. And I have to say it really has good geeat tips things you may have known but forgot them over the years. I am a type 1 diabetic for 30 years so over the years there is always new studies being done and you can learn a lot from the up to date studies and it is a lot easier now to count the calories and the carbohydrates in your food now then it was 30 years ago. You can found 100's of app with this information. I am thankful for this app.

Excellent guide for newly dx. diabetics, such as my dau Or longtime db patients, like my sister! I'm a retired medic/EMT, Master Gdnr, natural fds fan, gym rat & herbalist. They don't listen to a thing I say, so I'm fwdg this app, immediately! Thanks for your truly lifesaving app. Keep getting the word out. We, ALL need to heed the info, soon. Sugar's NOT synonymous w/life. In fact, I consider it the 'Anti-Life'! Though I decorate special occassion cakes, I offer natural options to ingrds.
